gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-bespoke-sans: Shantell Sans draws every curve with one fixed nib width, a wide-mouthed, hand-inked look with no calligraphic thinning anywhere. Bespoke Sans follows in sharp, refined sans-serif, leaving generous space where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-bespoke-sans: Chunky, level and unfussy. Sniglet stops its terminals short of curling back, while Bespoke Sans, a sharp sans-serif with generous gaps between curve ends and stems, keeps a long read light and refined.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-archivo: Stencil cut, tall and loud. Snowburst One leaves wide bridges between its letters, and Archivo sets curves opening outward beneath it with a commanding x-height, which makes the sturdiest anchor of the pair.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-asap: Stencil bridges, a sprung-paper-clip opening and tall lowercase give Snowburst One real swagger, while Asap sits underneath as readable sans-serif. Its body height nearly matches its capitals.
gen-dafont-nordic-switzer: Ancient and powerful, Nordic packs its letters tight with a cramped opening and one monoweight stroke. Switzer, a plain sans with tubular, wire-like forms and c tips that never close in, lets the page breathe beneath it.
gen-dafont-nulshock-work-sans: Nulshock stretches out with spacious tracking and a steady, unshaded outline. Its job is looking technical and bold up top, while Work Sans, a plain sans with a high mean line and open c tips, does the quiet, modern work of carrying the text.
gen-dafont-origami-fs-public-sans: Origami looks like a sign-painter's single-stroke brush at constant width, with a lowercase mass like poured lead type. Public Sans, a plain sans with a hefty lowercase and broad open counters, makes longer paragraphs feel trustworthy.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-supreme: Supreme sets a thick, heavy-looking strip of crisp text through the middle of each line, its letters held open rather than curled shut. And Outrun Future, with its wide-spaced outlines at one thickness and a large x-height, feels like a synthwave sign hovering just above it.
gen-dafont-starborn-satoshi: Dreamy, drifting, wide-spaced letters make Starborn feel ethereal, with a thick dark stripe of lowercase through every line. Satoshi, a sans-serif with a soaring x-height and open e, keeps a longer passage moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-merriweather-: Friendly, floating and a bit techy, Nasalization opens its c like calipers over short ascenders and a big lowercase body. And Merriweather Sans, a sans-serif with tall lowercase and a clearly open e, gives its words a sturdy, large presence.
